purpose: Lets a user commit to an action and make something happen immediately, such as submitting a form or confirming a choice. It is the most direct control in the system. For navigation to another place, use a Link instead.

props.name: size
props.description: Control size. Use sm only in dense or secondary contexts.

props.name: loading
props.description: Shows a busy spinner and blocks interaction while an action is in flight.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the button. Prefer hiding an action over disabling it when the user cannot know why it is unavailable.

props.name: children
props.description: The label. Use a verb that names the action, e.g. 'Save changes'.

variants.name: primary
variants.whenToUse: The single most important action in a view. There should be at most one primary button visible at a time.

variants.name: secondary
variants.whenToUse: A supporting action shown next to a primary one, such as Cancel beside Save.

variants.name: ghost
variants.whenToUse: A low-emphasis action where a bordered button would be visually heavy, such as a toolbar or a card footer.

states.name: hover
states.description: Pointer over the control; background shifts to the hover token.

states.name: focus
states.description: Keyboard focus; shows a visible 2px focus ring using the focus-ring token.

states.name: active
states.description: Pressed; background shifts to the active token.

states.name: disabled
states.description: Non-interactive; uses disabled surface and text tokens and not-allowed cursor.

states.name: loading
states.description: Action in flight; shows a spinner, sets aria-busy, and blocks interaction.

antiPatterns.never: Place two primary buttons in the same view.
antiPatterns.because: Primary signals the single most important action. Two of them removes the hierarchy and leaves the user unsure which matters.

antiPatterns.never: Use a Button to navigate to another page or URL.
antiPatterns.because: Navigation is a Link. Using a button breaks browser affordances like open-in-new-tab and confuses assistive technology about whether something will happen or somewhere will be visited.

antiPatterns.never: Disable a button without making the reason discoverable.
antiPatterns.because: A disabled control with no explanation reads as a dead end. Either show why it is disabled or hide it until it is available.

antiPatterns.never: Set raw colour or spacing values on the button.
antiPatterns.because: Unbound values are invisible to the design system and to an agent reading it. Always bind to a token.

accessibility.focus: Native focus order. Visible 2px focus ring on :focus-visible using the focus-ring token, offset by 2px.
aria: aria-disabled is not used; the native disabled attribute is preferred
accessibility.contrast: Primary text on brand and disabled text on disabled surface both meet WCAG AA 4.5:1 for the default token set.

agentNotes: When the surrounding context is a form submission, default to a primary Button labelled with the specific action verb, and pair it with a secondary Cancel. Never invent a destructive default; a delete action should be secondary or require confirmation.
